XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Air conditioning

  • Component: Low-pressure Freon connection

  • Fault: Abnormal refrigerant consumption in the air conditioning system.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Damaged low-pressure Freon connection

• Action: Check the condition of the low-pressure Freon fitting and replace it if necessary

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The fitting in question connects the air conditioning compressor to the condenser and is located in the engine compartment, on the passenger side. The rubber part of the fitting was found to be damaged at the bend; following its replacement, the fault was permanently resolved.
